title: Robin Kelley's biography of Monk
summary: He praises Kelley's book on Monk as suitable for a film.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: I don’t think everything has to be a dialectic.

I know, but I mean, of the things that you find that’s out there, there’s usually a protagonist up in there somewhere. Robin Kelley’s book on [Thelonius] Monk is interesting. His book on Monk is deeply historical, because I think he is a historian. He teaches somewhere, somewhere in California, I think.
No, I haven’t read it. I know Robin. We’ve served on panels together.

His book is very good. His book is good. I haven’t finished it yet. It would be perfect for a movie, in the right hands, but I can’t think of any right hands right now, because the first thing that people got to do, is they got to go get some money from somebody to make the movie. They’re subject to have Denzil playing Monk, which would be interesting. I can’t think of none of them dudes that I’ve seen that could play Monk anyway.
